title: Travel English Review
goals: mengulang **bandara, hotel, restoran, transportasi, belanja, darurat, dan obrolan ringan**
berlatih **percakapan** singkat yang sering terjadi saat bepergian

lesson.text: Unit ini mengulang seluruh level **Inggris untuk Bepergian**. Kerjakan latihan dan kuis, lalu ulangi unit yang masih terasa sulit.

lesson.title: Ringkasan pola penting
table: [[How much is ...?]] / [[How do I get to ...?]]
[[How do I get to the station?]]
[[Nice to meet you.]] / [[Where are you from?]]

lesson.title: Kalimat pendek lebih aman
lesson.text: Saat gugup, pakai kalimat pendek dan jelas: *One ticket, please.* *I need help.* Lawan bicara menghargai kejelasan lebih daripada kerumitan.

items: Pola sopan: I'd like ..., Could I have ...?
Tanya: Is there ...? How much ...? How do I get to ...?
Masalah: The ... is broken. I have lost ...
Berkenalan: Nice to meet you. Where are you from?
